label: human-21
people: [gecko]u6bkep (lobby rating 29), Armada, from B5 (placed by minutes.py from sightings); the user (computer_whisperer) hosting as a spectator
our_side: One seat, Cortex from G1 on the east strip: Opus 5.5 medium as the player (`run/human_game.sh human-21 medium normal claude-opus-5-5 seat claude-opus-5-5 high`) under an Opus 5.5 high commander (13 turns, 11 directions); Jev hands after the 2026-10-02 rebuild; group_A (five Rascals, one Incisor) on `lane rove` driven by code from 2:13.
summary: We opened three solars, then the plant at 1:08 (pool Cortex p75 1:03) with no turret, sent the first handful across at 2:30-2:39, found his plant at 2:55 and killed 210 of his for nothing by 3:25; at 4:00 we had 7 extractors and an army of 824, above the pool's p75. From 4:27 four Blitzes came in behind the base while the seven-Incisor raid stood about 1,500-2,000 in front under a packet that said it never comes home; the party name passed to one of his constructors, the body walked west, home and west again on the commander's 5:13 direction, and extractors fell from 7 to 3 by 5:25. u6bkep kept raiding with parties of 7-10 Blitzes (about 17 seen by 6:18), went to Stouts at 9:48 and Janus at 11:18, and fought the whole game in our half while expanding to 19 extractors. Our home held trades about even from 7:00 to 12:20, but extractors stayed at 3-7 against the pool's 11-24, the commander reversed the player's 6:18 Pounder switch at 6:20 and moved the home body south at 9:20 into a nine-unit raid, and a Stout and Janus army killed the plant at 14:02. The commander relocated to H7 at 15:20, conceded in chat at 17:16 after the host's "you could just surrender", and the game closed at 17:44 with one unit of ours.

root.what: The player's 3:51 packet (repeated at 4:11) was written with a Blitz at H3 in the report and the commander's 3:20 'Keep a turret or two at home against his Blitzes' in it. It left home to group_D, two Incisors, told the seven-Incisor group_B 'It never comes home and never sends detachments after lone raiders', and queued no turret at home. At 4:27 four Blitzes came in behind the base. The game was still on the path at 4:00: 7 extractors (pool p25 7), army 824 (pool p75 709), 210 of his killed for 0.
root.evidence: minutes.py 4:00 '824/0 ... lost 166 (H3)'; 5:00 'his mass G2 (57%) ... 495 (G1)'. analyze_match #0 4:25-5:12 G2: we lost 695 (5 cormex, 2 corsolar, 1 corcv), they lost 0; ours on the spot 480 + 0 turrets. 4:11 queue: turrets only at spot_3 (F1) and spot_25 (H3).

A stronger player keeps a light turret at the home cluster from about 2:00 and writes beforehand which body turns for a party in the base (the user's rule after this game).

their_play: u6bkep (Armada, lobby 29) opened on vehicles from B5 with a light turret at his outer extractors (our Rascals died to armllt at A6 at 3:51 and 9:38) and raided with Blitzes from 2:38: one Blitz at home at 2:38-3:25, the first extractor killed at 3:57 (H3), four Blitzes through H2, G1 and F1 from 4:20 to 5:25 while our raid stood forward, then parties of 7-10 Blitzes at 6:05 and 9:46 (about 17 seen by 6:18). He moved to Stouts (first seen 9:48) and Janus (11:18) and sent mixed raids of 7 Blitzes and 2-3 Stouts at 10:29, then a Stout and Janus army of about 1,800 that killed the plant at 14:02 and followed the commander south to H7. Every fight was in our half (our metal lost: 11,177 at our base, 292 in his half), he lost 945 in his half to our rovers, and he expanded from 13 known extractors at 9:20 to 19 at 15:20 (the commander's notes); no tier 2 was seen.

defects.defect: Party name passed to other units: party_4 (the raiders at our base) went to a constructor in his half at 4:32, so the packet's 'group_B attacks party_4 now' sent the body at B2 while party_11 shot the plant (K-hands-a-party-name-passed-to-other-units). The errand of 4:42-5:13 rests partly on it.
defects.evidence: hands_window 4:32: 'party_4=1 armcv@(1363,1708)'; 4:33 'party_11=3 armflash@(7558,1016)'; 4:50 'group_B: attack party_4 (1 armcv, 3 armflash) with the whole group [plan]'.

defects.defect: Turn latency: median 13.7 s wall a turn and orders in flight 86% of the game, so every raid answer landed 10-16 s after the report that prompted it (P2: above 10 s is harness-side).

defects.defect: The commander has no resign tool: asked to surrender at 17:12 it could only ask the host to end the game.
defects.evidence: chat 17:16 our player: 'I have no resign command, so please end it from the host side.' Ledger: 'the players' remove can destruct, the commander can only direct it'.

bears_on.id: The raid answer: who answers a raider, pickets, the turret with the spot, the 600 rule
bears_on.note: Source game of the in-base rule ('the answer must stand in the packet before the raid'). It also scopes 'a turret beside each outer pair is the picket': against a person's 7-10 Blitz parties, light turrets alone did not hold (12 of 25 losses had a turret within 700; commander 10:50: 'Light turrets alone don't hold against his 9-unit raids').
'the fault was the army's stationing': our army was above the pool's p75 at 4:00-6:00 (824/1,424/1,544) while four Blitzes took home, because the body stood forward under 'never comes home'.
Lost later to Stouts and Janus, but the commander's own summary and the record put the loss at extractors: 7 down to 3 at 4:27-5:25, then 3-7 through 12:00 while he went from 13 to 19.

'I like to make pounders for defence ... or all pounder if I am getting pushed': the player's 6:18 switch to Pounders for home defence matched this and the simulator; the commander's 6:20 reversal left Incisors as the bulk against Stouts and Janus.

The first handful crossed at 2:30-2:39 (pool Cortex 2:48), found his plant at 2:55 and killed 210 for 0 by 3:25; group_A was the best trade of the game (about 4:1, the existing review's attribution) but did not slow his expansion, and home fell behind it.

bears_on.id: Pressure from the first units: the first handful crosses the map
bears_on.note: Pressure met the pool's clock and paid, which shows it is necessary but not sufficient: without a home answer, his return raids cost us more than ours cost him.
Three solars with a constructor first (the reason he gave for three), but the plant came at 1:08 (>p75), energy stalled at 2:41, and metal sat at 0 from 3:07 with energy full.

bears_on.id: Energy in the opening: solars before and with the plant, the metal-bound first four minutes, the solar rule, the commander on the plant
bears_on.note: Three solars before the plant against the Cortex pool's 1/2/2; the store at 0-141 from 3:00 to 4:30 with energy full; the commander's 3:20 direction 'Add solars only when energy actually runs short'.
First construction turret begun 9:24 against the pool's 5:06, with the bank at 675-1,027 at 9:00-10:00 spent on a second plant frame that died.

bears_on.id: The bank and build power: what a bank means, what spends it first, build power on frames
bears_on.note: A bank of 1,034 at 9:31 on income 16-18 went into a second plant at home rather than build power; the commander's report had no build-power line (f6cfb6d added it after this game).

bears_on.id: Unit matchups and mixes: counters, the Blitz and the Stout, splash and spacing, body size
bears_on.note: Incisor 85 speed / 230 range against Blitz 101 / 180, Stout 350 and Janus 380 (units.csv); the Pounder beats all three in the simulator. Incisors chased what they could not catch and were outranged once he switched at 9:48-11:18.

bears_on.id: The commander's conduct: fights at home, builds at the plant, never toward what outreaches it, the early army
bears_on.note: The commander unit was the only answer to four Blitzes at the home spots from 4:56 to 5:12 ('attack party_11; its list step assist') and helped turn the 6:37-7:10 home fight; it survived to 17:44.

bears_on.id: Expansion and income: constructors by the clock, the midline, mohos and advanced solars, the late ladder
bears_on.note: Constructors were 3.0-6.1 alive (pool 4-8) but extractors stayed 3-7 from 6:00 to 12:00: turret-heavy lists, walks home on alarms, and three lists cancelled at 11:13.

The commander at 13:50 asked for one or two energy converters on a full energy store; Irishstud14's 'this is a metal heavy map. You won't need converters' was said of a healthy economy, not one at 4 extractors. Nothing in the record measures either.

Wrecks of about 2,800 metal lay at home at 13:50 (the commander's count) and 6,104 were reported by the end; the commander asked for reclaim at 6:20, 7:50, 10:50, 12:20 and 13:50, and at 14:16 the player set it aside because 'the wrecks lie under his army'.

lens.caveats: There is no truth file for a game with people: his numbers are what we saw (floors), and P3, known%, pred% and his curves cannot be checked. pro_baseline finds no pool from G1 as Cortex and runs only with --all-starts (39 Cortex sides), and its pressure rows are blank without a truth file. raid_ledger's 'paid' is 0 in every row although engagement #2 killed four Blitzes. floor and analyze_match print result '-' and 0.0 minutes. Extractor-loss counts differ: raid_ledger 25, analyze_match 24, wake_read 21. The record's enemy def ids do not map onto the header's unit_defs by id; first-sighting clocks are taken from the existing review. I differ from the existing review on the root: it puts the root at 0:00 (the opening list without a turret, last avoidable 3:51); I put it at 3:51, the packet, because at 4:00 the game was still on the path and the user's reading (the ledger) also points to the packet and the body's stationing. I add that the simulator backs the 6:18 Pounder switch, which the review left undetermined.

open_questions: Would group_B, recalled correctly at 4:27 (seven Incisors at about (5300, 730), roughly 1,700-2,100 from the home spots at speed 85), have saved spot_6 (5:12) and spot_3 (5:25), or only traded with Blitzes it cannot catch? This decides how much of the 7-to-3 drop rests on the since-fixed party-name fault.

Would a Pounder-led home body from 6:18, as the player chose, have held against a person's Blitz and then Stout and Janus raids? The simulator says yes head-on, but no game of ours with people measures it.
How much of the home wreck metal (2,800 at 13:50) did the constructors actually reclaim between raids? Nothing run here measures it.
